inheritance: PR #119 scalar-target ranking and PR #120 held-out NULL falsification remain frozen. All field, Japan38 history, colour stop-rule and absolute-time gates remain in force.

support_geometry_diagnostic.interpretation: Explicit process effects confined to among-taxon phenotype means, especially with shared scale coefficients, strongly improve the held-out support geometry relative to NULL_COUPLED but do not meet the preregistered adequacy gate. Process effects at both scales fail badly because they destroy the observed within-taxon non-support geometry.
support_geometry_diagnostic.stop_rule: Do not retune the five-family diagnostic. No existing v3 candidate is diagnostically adequate; any further mechanism refinement requires a separately versioned generator hypothesis.

next_scientific_gate.question: What extra structure, beyond generic among-only process loadings, can make growing-season-water support replication-stable while preserving within-taxon non-support?
next_scientific_gate.evidence: PROCESS_AMONG_ONLY_SHARED_COUPLED improves 8-cell matching and omnibus support, but joint among-taxon growing-season-water support occurs in only 25% of paired draws and the median remains 6/8.
next_scientific_gate.allowed_direction: A new version may predeclare structured among-taxon process effects, for example module-specific or predictor-specific loading sparsity motivated independently of the diagnostic outcome, while preserving the frozen v1 and held-out results as separate evidence layers.
next_scientific_gate.prohibited_direction: Do not alter v1 ranking, v120 held-out pattern, v123 adequacy thresholds, or retune the existing five v3 families.

claim_boundary: The diagnostic identifies a directional improvement toward among-taxon-only process structure but no adequate existing model. It is post-heldout, cannot change the frozen scalar-target winner, and does not identify a causal environmental process or prove modular adaptation.
